parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` — `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveRelease` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package: Metadata) and `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveArtist` in `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package: app:iOS). These are test-local mock implementations of what appears to be a `DiscogsEntityResolver` protocol, each stubbing a different method (`resolveRelease` vs `resolveArtist`) to satisfy the specific needs of their respective test suites. Consolidating them into a shared generic mock would couple two independent test packages and risk over-generalising fixtures that are intentionally minimal. The restraint-marker rule applies unconditionally here: both records are test fixtures.
